name: SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a restaurant group centered on Japanese cuisine, with roughly 600 eateries in Japan, Taiwan, Thailand and Indonesia. Its brands include Washoku Sato, Tendon Tempura Honpo Santen, Nigiri CHOJIRO, Katsuya and Karayama, and it also runs a traditional Japanese cafe called Meotozenzai. It was formerly called Sato Restaurant Systems Co., Ltd. and began in 1951.
